observation: Fresh 15 September reporting from multiple reputable outlets says Dylan Lucas is now a serious or 'big chance' Week 2 return candidate, including reporting attributing the development to Knights coach Justin Holbrook and Newcastle sources. This conflicts with NRL.com reporting published 12 September stating Newcastle officials contemplated a possible return only if the Knights reached the grand final.

sources.source: NRL.com — Lucas set for shock return — 12 Sep 2026
sources.finding: Grand-final return was the earliest club possibility reported at that time.

sources.source: Newcastle Herald — Dylan Lucas 58 days after horror injury: star poised for return — 15 Sep 2026
sources.finding: Reports Lucas poised for an extraordinary return.

sources.source: Daily Telegraph — NRL Finals Early Mail — 15 Sep 2026
sources.finding: Search-indexed report says Holbrook has confirmed Lucas is set for an extraordinary comeback; full article access unavailable this cycle.

audit_note: The 12 September official NRL report remains preserved and is not deleted. The fresh reports are later in time but are not treated as equivalent to an official Week 2 team list or direct medical clearance. Current MAYHEM state is therefore CONTRADICTED, not VERIFIED_AVAILABLE.
